headline: Monster Reborn
title: Monster Reborn Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Monster Reborn. What is it? It is a Normal Spell Card. What does it do? Target one monster in either player's Graveyard and Special Summon it. How do you use it? You can bring back your best monster, or steal your opponent's. It is Limited, so only one copy per Deck. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
